metadata.power_definition: Total prescribed absorbed plasma power; not generator power or a 40MHz voltage-derived input
metadata.energy_scope: 2001Eq3 reduced ground-neutral collisional closure; not complete reaction energies

metadata.not_implemented: 2001Eq8-16 core/edge width and density-normalization closure; no arbitrary core thickness was selected
metadata.surface: Source SUS/Fe probabilities used for comparison; not Si measurements; Tg is not Ts
metadata.reference_role: Source model predictions, not experimental measurements; signed difference is descriptive, not a fitted acceptance criterion
